issues.description: The five substantive programs are embedded in PDFs. STATA_DO.pdf marks each dataset load in prose but supplies no executable use/import statement or working-directory configuration. Extract and reflow copies; add ordinary relative-path loads for the matching table DTA files, including reloading Table 5A after clear.

The supplied SAS PDFs assume RSUBMIT/ENDRSUBMIT and PROC UPLOAD/DOWNLOAD but provide no LIBNAME, SAS/CONNECT session, remote-server, or data/output path configuration. The local SAS binary startup probe failed at TKELS; this does not establish whether SAS, SAS/CONNECT or SAS/ETS is licensed/configured.

The author program reads comp.WRDS_SEGMERGED while the matching local physical candidate is catalogued under a different libref. Configure a compatible COMP libref or stage the candidate at the program’s expected two-level name; this is ordinary path/library preparation and does not require proving original author-libref identity. The geotp value mapping and historical coverage remain separate unresolved data questions in REQ_COMP_SEGMENTS.

The supplied AvgFTR file defines caller-supplied n and dsetout and has a comment about five-year sums. The main and DM programs join fx.avgftr, but no macro call supplies n/output, and the main program does not document a producer order. Do not infer n=5 from the comment.

The complete SAS workflow contains import placeholders for the author’s Exhibit 21 country data, ICRG FX scores z1, political-stability fx.ps, capital-control fx.cc, and hand-collected fx.hedge. Their products, files, editions, field/date coding and sample coverage are not supplied or fully specified; local SEC directory roots alone do not establish the coded hedge data.

The stock program names 2010-base BIS broad/narrow real-effective-exchange-rate indices but assumes exp.fxi returns already exist. It does not identify exact series codes, country weights/mapping, the index-to-return transformation or the author-era vintage/history matching the stated 61/27-economy universe. Native BIS REER inputs must be retained; nominal FX/NEER measures are not substitutes.

SAS_Stock Ret Test consumes exp.hedge(ciknumber,fyear,hedge), while SAS_Main only names hand-collected fx.hedge and builds fx.hedge1/2 with matched_date_hedge, l4FX_contract and l4Hedge before a winsorize/export placeholder. No supplied code establishes that these data or schemas are the same or exports exp.hedge.

Required SAS branches span multiple PDFs and share generated data: the AvgFTR macro output is joined by Main and DM, DM explicitly says to run Main to obtain z7, and the stock-return branch uploads Main’s Comp03_all. The exact macro call, shared local/remote library state and executable order are not fully documented; preserve all companion branches and verify producers before consumers.

The supplied SAS programs leave winsorization and export as placeholders for the main Compustat sample, financial/operational hedge tables, DM table and Table 7 branch. They do not identify or demonstrate creation of all six final Table 3/4/5A/5B/6/7 DTA files consumed by Stata; the exact final output contract and placement are unresolved.

evidence.description: The stock-return branch joins Compustat cluster dates and BIS cumulative-return dates within the source’s ±10-day windows.

on a.permno = b.permno and -10<=intck('day', b.cluster, a.datadate)<=10

actions.description: Prepare the supplied analysis-only route from the actual PDF and DTA artifacts.
steps: In an assigned working copy, extract/reflow STATA_DO.pdf to a .do file; retain all authored equations, transformations, samples, and table order.

Set the Stata working directory to the analysis-data folder using relative paths. Insert `use "Table 3.dta", clear` at the Table 3 marker, then corresponding loads for Tables 4, 5A, 5B, 6, and 7 at their markers; reload Table 5A after the existing clear.
Install the exact vce2way package through its verified repository route before Table 6; keep reghdfe and ftools on the active adopath for Table 7.

Run sections sequentially: Table 3 H1; Table 4 functional currency; Table 5A indicator then contract/assets; Table 5B breadth then reversed-sign depth; Table 6 baseline then full nonlinear model; Table 7 narrow then broad bootstrap regressions.
Capture a text log and save any result tables to the working output folder; record the manual Table 6 parameter-name adjustment described by the source.
validation: Confirm each DTA loads with the required fields listed in its requirement, and confirm no table section consumes a prior section’s modified data unintentionally.

Confirm Stata 18 resolves vce2way and that the supplied vce2way nlsur cluster(gvkey fyear) call runs with the expected two-way clustering; do not change the estimator or cluster keys without author evidence.
Confirm Table 7 resolves reghdfe and ftools and reports the expected absorbed dimensions and GVKEY bootstrap cluster.
Compare sample counts, summaries, coefficients, and output tables with the paper after authorized execution; this assessment did not execute regressions.

actions.description: Install the absent vce2way Stata module from its verified public software repository, then check the exact Table 6 invocation in Stata 18.
steps: In the authorized host Stata environment, install vce2way from its documented SSC repository using the reported package name.
Keep the downloaded ado/help files in the active Stata PLUS/adopath; do not substitute a different estimator or cluster command.
validation: Run `which vce2way` in the authorized Stata 18 environment.
After extracting the source and loading Table 6.dta, validate the authored `vce2way nlsur ..., cluster(gvkey fyear)` command and preserve both cluster variables.

actions.description: Map the catalogued Compustat, geographic-segment, CCM and CRSP candidates through compatible local/remote libraries, then verify required year and population coverage before preparing the author-defined inputs.
steps: Map the physical geographic-segment candidate at ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_seghist/wrds_segmerged.sas7bdat through a compatible COMP libref or stage it under the two-level name comp.WRDS_SEGMERGED. The catalog label COMPSEG versus COMP is an ordinary configuration detail, not an author-byte identity requirement.
Verify annual Compustat history supports the 1997–2017 target plus t−4 controls and t−5 functional-currency rows; obtain the AvgFTR n contract separately before claiming its rolling-history coverage.
Verify that CCM link dates and types cover the author join filters and fiscal intervals.

Verify monthly CRSP files cover all included clusters and the nested inclusive 0–59-month windows. With complete continuous monthly data this is up to 119 total observations including the cluster month (118 prior); preserve the source count-completeness conditions and ±10-day fiscal-date matching.
After the exact mappings and coverage are established, prepare inputs using the supplied SAS selection and joins without replacing variables, sample filters, link rules or estimators.
validation: Confirm each mapped source has the fields recorded in its requirement and that required annual/monthly history is present; one-row probes establish readability/columns only.
Check geotp values against the author’s _2=dsale and _3=fsale transpose contract and verify required date history; these meaning/coverage checks remain separate from libref staging.

review_notes: The package static audit marked no supported code, but all five supplied program PDFs contain substantive SAS or Stata preparation/analysis programs; the datasheet identifies the six corresponding final DTA analysis inputs.

The six bounded DTA header/read probes confirm separate table datasets and table-specific consumer fields: Table 3 (5,432 rows), Table 4 (5,432), Table 5A (6,271), Table 5B (5,432), Table 6 (5,736), and Table 7 (3,186). Header row counts are DTA file metadata and do not establish sample/date fidelity. All fields consumed by each matching Stata section are present.

A supported analysis_only route exists from the six packaged DTA inputs to Stata Tables 3–7 after extracting/reflowing the embedded PDF and adding the indicated table-specific loads. Stata 18, reghdfe 6.12.3 and ftools 2.49.1 are available. vce2way is absent from the active Stata adopath; its exact repository/install route is recorded as setup evidence. No regression was run.

Full-pipeline local raw candidates were checked with bounded one-row SAS reads: COMP.FUNDA, the geographic segment file, COMP.COMPANY, CCMXPF LINKTABLE, CRSP MSF, MSEALL and MSI. Matching source fields support local candidate routes, but exact history/population coverage remains unverified. The geographic file can be staged through a compatible COMP libref as ordinary configuration; geotp category meaning and historical coverage remain unresolved. SAS row counts from those probes are not claimed.

The full SAS workflow also requires Exhibit 21, ICRG FX and political-stability, capital-control, and hand-coded hedge inputs. Datasheet source URLs are preserved as unverified candidates. The Main and DM branches share the AvgFTR and FX-risk intermediates; the macro caller/parameter/output is unspecified and SAS_DM explicitly requires z7 from Main. The stock-return branch requires CRSP, native 2010-base BIS REER broad/narrow measures and exp.fxi return fields, 60-month cumulative returns plus a 60-observation estimation window (under complete continuous data the nested union is 119 total monthly observations including the cluster month, 118 prior months), source count-completeness rules and ±10-day fiscal-date matching, and a separate exp.hedge input with no documented producer/handoff.

SAS runtime/CONNECT/ETS availability is unverified because the bounded SAS startup probe failed at TKELS. SAS PDFs leave runtime/session/library configuration, several manual data imports, macro invocation, winsorization and final export contracts unresolved; they do not demonstrate production of all six DTA table outputs. Full-pipeline closure is therefore incomplete and this scope is not represented as a raw-data reproduction success.

No author code was executed, imported, compiled or edited; no study data were downloaded or imported; no regressions or installations were run. Only bounded source/PDF inspection, DTA header/one-row reads, authorized one-row SAS metadata/data probes, exact path checks and tiny self-written software probes were used. The frozen dependency checklist is empty; no synthetic dependency identifiers were added.

Datasheet lines 24–37 identify author-source candidates: the EX-21 dataset URL, ICRG subscription provider, NBER w20970 capital-controls appendix, and BIS EER page. These routes are recorded as unverified candidates only; current availability, required fields, exact variables, coverage and historical vintages remain unresolved.
